to fail to win a game or competition. We sometimes lose, but we still enjoy playing.
a group of people who play a sport or game together. There are five players on our team.
a person who takes part in a sport or game. Each player has a number.

articulation.alt: play: /p/ → /l/ → /eɪ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
/l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
/ɪ/: Raise the front tongue; narrow the jaw gap.
